open_obligations.what_is_open: A uniform proof of strict full-count improvement for every later positive even population size, or a certified later counterexample, remains open.
open_obligations.obstruction: The eight-unit separating rule does not embed into a later balanced experiment: padding changes the treated allocation mixture and introduces new response-type states whose risks are uncontrolled by the finite certificate.
open_obligations.attempted: The exact eight-unit witness and the general information inequality were checked, but neither supplies a legal all-size perturbation or a least-favorable scalar support characterization.

open_obligations.what_is_open: The first nonzero asymptotic normalization and the leading or subsequential limits of the balance-compression minimax tax remain open.
open_obligations.obstruction: Four finite games do not control the bivariate hypergeometric boundary layer or its projection uniformly as the even population size diverges.
open_obligations.attempted: The exact finite tax values and sandwich were derived; no uniform two-coordinate local expansion with remainder control follows from these certificates.
